logp.method_description: The determination of lipid water partition coefficient refers to the method reported in the literature[11]. A 200 μL solution of the complex (2 mM) is mixed with an equal volume of n-octanol water two-phase system (2 mL each), and the two phases are separated by centrifugation after 24 hours of vortex oscillation. The concentration of the complex in both phases is determined by UV visible spectrophotometry. The logarithmic value of the concentration ratio of the complex in n-octanol and water is the lipid water partition coefficient (logPo/w).
